data.one_liner: A customizable timer widget with millisecond support and a controller.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable timer widget and controller to handle count up or count down scenarios. Supports millisecond precision, custom builders, and runtime manipulations like start, pause, reset, jump, and interval changes.
use_when: You need a custom countdown or count-up timer widget with flexible formatting.
You require runtime control over a timer such as pausing, starting, and jumping to specific durations.
avoid_when: You need background services or alarms that persist when the app is terminated.
strengths: Includes a robust controller for timer manipulation (start, pause, reset, finish, add, subtract, jumpTo).
Supports millisecond precision and customizable intervals.
Provides a clean custom builder pattern for UI rendering.
weaknesses: Requires SingleTickerProviderStateMixin in the parent widget for ticker provision.
Lacks background persistence out of the box.
